title: Slice test: workflow-close regression net + split verification (D4)
action: One trailing test cell for the slice's NET behavior. In the suite that owns workflow-store/state-projection coverage (extend, never fork — locate first; likely packages/bee/tests/test_workflow_store.mjs): (a) a startFeature chain of 3 features leaves exactly the last live, the prior two status 'closed'; (b) a seeded zombie record (status active, phase compounding-complete) is never returned by pickNewestActiveWorkflow with feature unset; (c) rebuildStateProjection with the current feature live + zombies present preserves phase/feature (no resurrection). For fx-2: assert both split suite filenames are present in scripts/impact-registry.json. All green.
